_metadata.description: Skeleton double-wishbone vehicle demonstrating the v0.99.2 glTF visual binding layer: bindings on the upright, both wishbones, the tie rod/toe link, spring, damper, brake disc and caliper, wheel, steering rack, column and steering wheel, engine, gearbox and an aero component.
_metadata.author: SVJ working draft — visual binding example

data_origin.detail: Generic skeleton. Geometry, masses and rates are representative engineering values, not a specific vehicle. The .glb files referenced in assets.meshes are placeholders and are not part of this repository.
